description: Aaron Thomas is a small business owner who is committed to improving the lives of Alabamians. We need common-sense representation in Montgomery — one that puts parents first, defends the Constitution, secures our elections, and cuts through the red tape that slows down small businesses. I support the rule of law and those who enforce it, responsible budgeting, and making sure state government works for the people. Vote Aaron Thomas for House District 10
